definitions.explanation: The administrative office of a city government where residents can access various municipal services.

examples.japanese: {市役所|しやくしょ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}→住民票：09628_juuminhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧。
examples.english: I get a certificate of residence at city hall.

examples.japanese: {市役所|しやくしょ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{近|ちか}く→近く：00923_chikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: City hall is near the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したら→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧{市役所|しやくしょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}け{出|で}→届出：07555_todokede⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧し⟦なければならない→なければならない：27600_nakerebanaranai⟧。
examples.english: When you move, you must file a notification at city hall.

notes:
{市役所|しやくしょ} combines ⟦{市|し}→市：01599_shi⟧ (city) + ⟦{役所|やくしょ}→役所：06455_yakusho⟧ (government office).

RELATED GOVERNMENT OFFICES:
- ⟦{区役所|くやくしょ}→区役所：21563_kuyakusho⟧ (ward office - in Tokyo, etc.)
- ⟦{町役場|まちやくば}→町役場：13579_machiyakuba⟧/⟦{村役場|むらやくば}→村役場：24018_murayakuba⟧ (town/village office)
- ⟦{県庁|けんちょう}→県庁：27822_kenchou⟧ (prefectural office)

COMMON SERVICES:
- ⟦{住民票|じゅうみんひょう}→住民票：09628_juuminhyou⟧ (certificate of residence)
- ⟦{戸籍|こせき}→戸籍：12695_koseki⟧{謄本|とうほん} (family register copy)
- ⟦{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}→転入届：09811_tennyuutodoke⟧ (move-in notification)
- ⟦{印鑑|いんかん}→印鑑：05290_inkan⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧ (seal registration)

USAGE:
- An essential word for anyone living in Japan
- Various forms and certificates must be obtained here
